justification: Insufficient modularization is present. In [BaseNodeMetaModel.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/javaparser/javaparser/javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/BaseNodeMetaModel.java) the class is 247 lines long, has 9 fields, and exposes 20 public methods; those methods span several concerns: metadata storage, inheritance traversal (`getAllPropertyMetaModels`, `isInstanceOfMetaModel`, `isRootNode`), naming/identity helpers (`getQualifiedClassName`, `getTypeNameGenerified`, `getMetaModelFieldName`, `equals`, `hashCode`, `toString`), and reflective node construction (`construct`). [JavaParserMetaModel.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/javaparser/javaparser/javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/JavaParserMetaModel.java) and [NodeMetaModel.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/javaparser/javaparser/javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/NodeMetaModel.java) show it is a shared base for many generated metamodels, but [BaseNodeMetaModelTest.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/javaparser/javaparser/javaparser-core-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/BaseNodeMetaModelTest.java) only exercises one small helper, so the class concentrates multiple separable responsibilities in one abstraction.
